description: Mechanical keyboard and mouse sounds for every keystroke and click, with customizable sound packs.
notes: Scoop does not register the mechvibes:// protocol or create the optional startup task.
An existing Mechvibes 2 installation is not removed automatically; uninstall it first if both copies would otherwise run at the same time.
Settings and custom sound packs remain under %APPDATA%\Mechvibes, outside the Scoop app directory.
